eventText: A coworker takes credit for your idea in a team meeting.

success.outcomeText: You made your case. Your manager noticed.

failure.outcomeText: It came across as petty. You looked worse.

choices.outcomeText: You kept the peace, but it stings.
Your manager appreciated the professionalism.

eventText: Your mother calls and wants to talk for an hour. You're busy.

choices.outcomeText: It was nice to catch up.
You feel a twinge of guilt.

eventText: Your car makes an alarming grinding noise on the way to work.

choices.text: Take it to the mechanic immediately.
choices.outcomeText: It was the brake pads. Cheaper than it could have been.

eventText: Your boss asks you to stay late three nights this week.

choices.outcomeText: Your dedication was noticed. Your bank account appreciated it too.
Your boss seemed annoyed, but your sanity is intact.

eventText: Your neighbour throws a loud party that goes until 3am.

choices.text: Knock on their door and ask them to keep it down.

success.outcomeText: They apologised and turned it down.

failure.outcomeText: They told you to lighten up.

choices.outcomeText: The music stopped an hour later. Worth it.

choices.text: Put in earplugs and try to sleep.
choices.outcomeText: You survived, barely.

eventText: A friend invites you to catch up over dinner.

choices.outcomeText: It was exactly what you needed.
Your friend was disappointed. You stayed home anyway.

eventText: You've been meaning to join a gym for months. There's a sign-up deal on.

choices.outcomeText: You actually went three times this week.

choices.text: Tell yourself you'll start next month.
choices.outcomeText: You won't.

eventText: You have to present the quarterly report to the leadership team.

choices.outcomeText: You nailed it. The CEO complimented your clarity.

failure.outcomeText: It was a disaster. You blanked on the third slide.

eventText: You pull yourself up on the sofa and eye the gap across the living room. Everyone is watching.

success.outcomeText: You wobbled all the way across to cheers and applause.

failure.outcomeText: You landed on your bottom. You'll try again tomorrow.

choices.outcomeText: Walking can wait. You got there first anyway.

eventText: You have invented an imaginary friend called Mr Biscuit. Your parents want to know why he needs his own chair at dinner.

choices.text: Insist Mr Biscuit gets a chair.
choices.outcomeText: Mr Biscuit enjoyed his dinner. Your parents set an extra place for months.

choices.text: Tell them Mr Biscuit moved away.
choices.outcomeText: You missed him a little, but dinner was quieter.

eventText: At the supermarket, your parent says no to the toy you have been staring at for ten minutes.

choices.text: Throw a tantrum in the aisle.

success.outcomeText: They gave in just to make it stop. You got the toy.

failure.outcomeText: You were carried out screaming. No toy, and no dessert.

choices.outcomeText: They said maybe for your birthday. You felt very grown up.

choices.text: Sulk all the way to the checkout.
choices.outcomeText: Nobody noticed your sulking. Rude.

eventText: It's your first day of school. The classroom is loud, bright, and full of strangers.

choices.text: Introduce yourself to the kid next to you.
choices.outcomeText: You made a best friend before lunch.

choices.text: Cling to your parent at the gate.
choices.outcomeText: They peeled you off eventually. By home time it wasn't so bad.

choices.text: Head straight for the book corner.
choices.outcomeText: The teacher was impressed by how quietly you read.

eventText: An older kid shoves you off the swings at recess and laughs about it with his friends.

success.outcomeText: He backed off. Nobody bothers you on the swings now.

failure.outcomeText: You lost the scuffle and got detention as well.

choices.outcomeText: The teacher sorted it out, though a few kids called you a snitch.
You found some new friends building forts in the sandpit.

eventText: The family dog slipped out through the gate yesterday and still hasn't come home.

choices.text: Put up posters around the neighbourhood.

success.outcomeText: A neighbour called. She was two streets over, raiding someone's bin.

failure.outcomeText: You never found her. You still think about her sometimes.

choices.text: Wait for her to come home on her own.

success.outcomeText: She wandered home three days later, muddy and very pleased with herself.

failure.outcomeText: She never came back. The house feels quieter.

eventText: Your school is holding a science fair. Everyone else seems to be building a volcano.

success.outcomeText: Your homemade weather station won first prize.

failure.outcomeText: It didn't work on the day, but you learned a lot building it.

choices.text: Build a volcano like everyone else.
choices.outcomeText: It erupted on cue. Solid participation ribbon.
You stayed home and watched cartoons. Nobody was fooled.

eventText: You have a big exam tomorrow, and your friends are messaging you to join them online.

choices.outcomeText: You walked out of the exam knowing you'd nailed it.

success.outcomeText: You winged it and somehow passed.

failure.outcomeText: You failed. Your parents were not impressed.

choices.text: Study for an hour, then log on.
choices.outcomeText: A respectable pass and a fun night. Balance.

eventText: You have a huge crush on someone in your class. You can't stop thinking about them.

success.outcomeText: They said yes! You went to the movies and barely watched the film.

failure.outcomeText: They laughed. The whole year group knew by lunchtime.

choices.text: Write about it in your diary.
choices.outcomeText: Your secret is safe. For now.
They promised not to tell anyone, and actually kept it.

eventText: At a party, some older kids hand you a drink and laugh when you hesitate.

choices.outcomeText: You felt cool for an hour, then sick for the rest of the night.

choices.text: Say no and stay at the party.
choices.outcomeText: A couple of people teased you. Most didn't care at all.

choices.text: Text your parents for a lift home.
choices.outcomeText: An awkward ride home, but you were glad to be out of there.

eventText: The café down the road is looking for weekend staff. The pay isn't much, but it's money.

choices.outcomeText: You spent the year making coffee and quietly saving up.
Lazy Saturdays are worth more than money. For now.
